messages.subject: lavaan-Onyx results
parts:
Dear members of the community,

I am using Onyx (http://onyx.brandmaier.de/) to get the lavaan syntax for the specification of my model. When I compared the results provided by Onyx and those provided by running the code in the R console, I could see that the results are practically the same (little variations exist in the estimated parameters for a measurement model). However, when I do the same with a structural model, now I see important differences between Onyx results and R-lavaan results... Why is that so?

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: lavaan-Onyx results
parts: Hard to know without details, but given what you have provided, it may be that different assumptions or defaults are imposed on the structural model. Probably, if you compare the structural models closely, you will find paths estimated in one model but not in another.
